title: Trip Service API
instructions: Build the trip-booking API in `main.py`: Pydantic models `TripCreate`, `TripOut` and `TripRecord`, and an `APIRouter` mounted at `/trips` with POST, list, GET and DELETE routes. Never expose fare or payout fields, map `SurgeCapExceeded` to a 409 with a stable body, and validate path and query parameters with `Query`, aliases and UUIDs. Keep the in-memory storage named `_TRIPS`.

evidence.label: POST /trips returns 201 and only the public TripOut fields
Computes fare (250 + round(km * 120)) and payout (80%) in the stored record
Rejects invalid bodies with 422 and accepts boundary values and the default zone
GET /trips/{id} returns the public fields of the stored trip
Returns 404 {"detail": "trip not found"} for unknown ids and 422 for malformed UUIDs
Lists trips with the ?limit= and ?status= filters
Returns 422 for limit 0, limit 101 and an unknown status
DELETE returns 204 with no body, then the trip is gone (404)
OpenAPI documents the routes and the DELETE 404; handlers are async def
